title: refs/notes/* refused by pre-receive hook at the remote
body:
Gitea version: `Gitea Version: 1.16.0+dev-104-g3a6edd368` git: `git version 2.33.0.rc2.250.ged5fa647cd` built from: `sources` run with: `systemd` OS: `Arch Linux` I am getting this when I try to push notes with `git push -u origin refs/notes/"*":refs/notes/"*"`, TLDR pre-receive hook rejects them. as @zeripath noted, this might be indicative of a regression.
